OLM LE Dry Carbon Fiber Switch Panel Covers

OLM's premium carbon fiber line looks great inside and outside of your vehicle. The trim pieces and style to a relatively dull interior. This piece attaches with the pre-applied 3M double sided adhesive. Simply clean the surface of the factory pieces and attach the new piece.

Highlights:

  • This piece is gloss coated to perfection.
  • Expertly crafted in Japan and tested fitting in the US.
